fact_text: A third-country national applies for the residencia temporaria as a hired worker online through Migraciones' RADEX system, and must be physically inside Argentine territory to do so; the RADEX residence request is not lodged at a consulate abroad.
evidence_quote: Es necesario que te encuentres dentro del territorio de la República Argentina.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: you obtain a work visa at an Argentine consulate before travelling. Actually: the RADEX residence application must be filed from within Argentine territory (the consular Permiso de Ingreso is the separate route for those still abroad). Action: file the residence request via RADEX once the employee is in Argentina, or use the consular entry-permit route first.

fact_text: The residencia temporaria granted to a hired migrant worker is issued for a term of one year and is renewable (prorrogable).
evidence_quote: Se otorga una residencia temporaria por un plazo de 1 año, prorrogable.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: an employer-sponsored residence covers the whole assignment. Actually: it is granted for 1 year at a time and must be renewed. Action: diarise the renewal (prórroga), including a fresh employer RENURE proof if the employer changes, before the 1-year expiry.

entity_title: Employer must be registered in RENURE
fact_text: Before an employer can request the admission of a foreign worker, the requesting entity (Requirente) must be registered in the Registro Nacional Único de Requirentes de Extranjeros (RENURE) of the Dirección Nacional de Migraciones.
evidence_quote: la entidad Requirente del ingreso de un extranjero deberá encontrarse inscripta en el Registro Nacional Único de Requirentes de la Dirección Nacional de Migraciones (Disposición DNM 54.618/2008)

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: the employee applies for their own work permit. Actually: the sponsoring employer must first be enrolled in RENURE before the entry/residence request can proceed. Action: confirm the Argentine employing entity holds a valid RENURE registration before starting the worker's file.

entity_title: Sponsored salary must match the collective agreement
fact_text: The pre-employment contract filed for the worker residence must state remuneration that conforms to the collective bargaining agreement (convenio colectivo) for the activity to be performed.
evidence_quote: Remuneración a percibir (deberá ajustarse al convenio colectivo de trabajo de la actividad a desarrollar)

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: any agreed salary is acceptable for the sponsorship. Actually: the declared remuneration must match the sector's convenio colectivo. Action: benchmark the offered salary against the applicable convenio colectivo before both parties sign the pre-contract.

entity_title: AFIP alta temprana due within 30 days
fact_text: The employer's AFIP 'alta temprana' certificate (early registration of the employment relationship), signed by the employer, must be presented within thirty running days of initiating the residence request.
evidence_quote: deberá presentarse dentro del plazo de treinta (30) días corridos a partir del inicio de la solicitud de residencia

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: employment registration can wait until the residence is granted. Actually: the AFIP alta temprana must be filed within 30 running days of starting the residence request. Action: have the employer complete the alta temprana in AFIP promptly after the RADEX filing.

entity_title: Residencia precaria valid up to 90 days
fact_text: Once the residence application is initiated and until it is resolved, Migraciones may grant a 'residencia precaria'; under the current text of Law 25.871 its validity is up to 90 running days and it may be renewed by a reasoned decision of the migration authority.
evidence_quote: Su validez será de hasta NOVENTA (90) días corridos y podrá ser renovada por resolución fundada de la referida autoridad migratoria.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: the precaria lasts 180 days. Actually: under the current (reformed) Law 25.871 the precaria is valid for up to 90 running days, renewable by founded resolution. Action: track the precaria expiry and renew it before it lapses while the residence is pending.

entity_title: Work legally on a precaria plus CUIL
fact_text: A foreigner who holds a residencia precaria granted by Migraciones together with a CUIL (Código Único de Identificación Laboral) issued by ANSES may already work in Argentina.
evidence_quote: el Código Único de Identificación Laboral (CUIL) otorgado por la Administración Nacional de la Seguridad Social (ANSES) puede trabajar en el país

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: you cannot start working until the final residence and DNI are issued. Actually: a precaria plus an ANSES-issued CUIL already authorises working. Action: obtain the CUIL from ANSES as soon as the precaria is granted so the employee can be put on payroll legally.

entity_title: Precaria does not count toward permanent residence
fact_text: Time spent on a residencia precaria is not valid residence for proving arraigo toward permanent residence, nor for acquiring nationality by naturalisation.
evidence_quote: ni resulta residencia válida a los efectos de acreditar arraigo, necesario para la obtención de la residencia permanente, o para la adquisición de la nacionalidad por naturalización.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: months on a precaria count toward permanent residence and citizenship. Actually: precaria time does not qualify as valid residence for arraigo (permanent residence) or naturalisation. Action: count only granted temporary/permanent residence time when planning permanent-residence or citizenship eligibility.

entity_title: DNI requires a valid DNM residence
fact_text: A foreign national can process the Argentine DNI only while holding a valid permanent or temporary residence issued by the Dirección Nacional de Migraciones; if it is missing, expired, or expiring within 60 days they must first regularise their status with Migraciones.
evidence_quote: Si tenés residencia permanente o temporaria vigente emitida por la Dirección Nacional de Migraciones, podés tramitar tu DNI.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: the DNI is a standalone ID you request on arrival. Actually: the foreigner DNI is issued off a valid DNM residence and lapses with it. Action: secure the residence (or precaria then residence) first, then process the foreigner DNI at RENAPER.

entity_title: Consular entry permit: DNI within 60 business days
fact_text: A worker admitted through a consular Permiso de Ingreso and visa becomes automatically radicado (residence established) on entry and must process the DNI at the Registro Nacional de las Personas within sixty business days of entering the country.
evidence_quote: quedan automáticamente radicados, debiendo tramitar – en caso de corresponder – su DNI ante el Registro Nacional de las Personas, en el plazo de sesenta (60) días hábiles de producido el ingreso.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: there is no fixed deadline to obtain the DNI after arrival. Actually: once admitted via the entry permit the person is automatically radicado and must obtain the DNI within 60 business days of entry. Action: book the RENAPER/registro civil DNI appointment immediately after arrival.

entity_title: Provisional CUIT for residents without a DNI
fact_text: A foreign resident without an Argentine DNI can obtain a provisional CUIT (tax identification key) from ARCA; it is assigned for a maximum validity of 2 years or limited to the residence admission period, and must be replaced once the Argentine DNI is obtained.
evidence_quote: se asigna CUIT por un plazo de validez máximo de 2 años (o condicionada al plazo de admisión -residencia transitoria/temporaria-) dispuesta por la autoridad de aplicación.

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: you need the DNI before you can hold a CUIT tax ID. Actually: ARCA issues a provisional CUIT to a temporary resident without a DNI, capped at 2 years or the admission period. Action: obtain the provisional CUIT via ARCA to enable tax/payroll set-up, then replace it (within 10 business days of getting the DNI) with the DNI-based CUIT.

entity_title: Argentine police certificate is built into RADEX
fact_text: The Argentine criminal-record certificate (Antecedentes Penales) required for the residence is integrated into the RADEX application, so it does not have to be requested at any office or on any other web platform.
evidence_quote: La solicitud del certificado de Antecedentes Penales Argentinos está integrada a esta aplicación, por lo cual no tenés que tramitarlo en ninguna dependencia ni en otra plataforma web que no sea ésta

applies_to.non_obvious_note: Commonly believed: you must separately obtain and pay for the Argentine police certificate before applying. Actually: RADEX generates the Antecedentes Penales request inside the same application. Action: do not pay a gestor to obtain the Argentine criminal record separately (note it is handled outside RADEX only if the preferential-appointment option is chosen).
